title: Coordinate Window Border Effect Cycles
description: Phase-lock loading, waiting, introduced, and celebrate border effects via shared :root CSS clocks.
summary: Border effects (loading, waiting, introduced, celebrate) now share document-level phase clocks on unlayered :root. Inheritable @property tokens drive element rings, window silhouettes, and CelebrateContent paint; consumers no longer start local spin/pulse animations. 3D celebrate conic uses document.timeline for CSS phase lock. Added CSS contract vitest for root clocks and paint-only consumers.
